units.summary: The company wanted FAIR to help choose and scope its first proof of concept, with freight document processing as its leading candidate.
units.quote: Help to choose and scope the first proof of concept - the company leans towards freight document processing.

units.summary: The company sought technical advice on document extraction, TMS API integration, and human-in-the-loop design.
units.quote: Technical advice on document extraction approach (OCR vs. vision language models), on how to integrate with the TMS API, and on human-in-the-loop design.

units.summary: The company wanted an assessment of whether its WMS data was suitable for forecasting.
units.quote: An assessment of whether the WMS data is good enough for forecasting.

units.summary: The company sought guidance on an AI usage policy and on GDPR and AI Act obligations, particularly for customer service.
units.quote: Guidance on an AI usage policy for staff, GDPR and AI Act obligations (especially for the customer service use case).

units.summary: The company was interested in possibly having a Master's thesis student work on forecasting in spring 2027.
units.quote: Possibly a Master's thesis student for the forecasting topic (spring 2027).

units.summary: The company wanted help with a funding application if the proof of concept looked promising.
units.quote: Help with a funding application if the PoC looks promising.

units.summary: The company was interested in public funding from Business Finland or the ELI Center and said it would need help applying.
units.quote: We are also interested in public funding, Business Finland or the ELI Center, but we have never applied, so we would need help with that.

units.summary: The advisors offered to help with parts of the funding application.
units.quote: We can help with the funding part, at least with parts of the application.

units.topic: AI policy and Copilot training recommendation
units.summary: The advisors recommended an AI usage policy and short practical Copilot training, regardless of the pilots.
units.quote: And fourth, regardless of the pilots, we recommend an AI usage policy and short practical training on Copilot.

units.summary: The advisor said she would send an AI usage policy template and a list of possible funding instruments.
units.quote: I'll send you an AI usage policy template and a list of possible funding instruments.

units.summary: The company said a thesis worker in spring 2027 would be welcome.
units.quote: A thesis worker in spring 2027 would be great.
